Only one wallet is unlocked at a time; switching locks the current one.
Pearl (PRL) in your pocket. Same keys as the desktop wallet, none of the weight.
Keys are created and stay on this phone, encrypted and biometric-gated.

Balances, history and mining rewards from the Pearl indexer. No chain download.

Tap an address to copy it. Derivation: m/86’/%1$d’/0’/branch/index, BIP-86 key path like the desktop wallet. Each index also has a post-quantum variant (XMSS tapleaf from purpose 222’) that is watched and listed here once it has been used. The refresh button checks every address, both variants, right now; the home screen only checks the ones in use.

Regular release line: normal updates install here. From here you can only go down. Going down puts you on alternate builds, where from then on you can only keep going down — until you go back up, and then only up.
Alternate build: normal updates don’t install. You can keep going down to older versions, or go up to any version with its return build. Once you go up, there’s only up.
Alternate build: normal updates don’t install, and from here there’s only up — newer return builds. To go down again, reset.
Alternate rollback build. Normal updates don’t install. Downgrades still work; going up puts you on the forward-only return lane.
Alternate return build. Normal updates don’t install. From here there’s only forward; going down again needs a reset.

PocketPRL is an independent, open-source light wallet for the Pearl network. It derives the same addresses as the official desktop wallet (oyster) and is verified against it with test vectors generated from the Pearl source code.
This software is provided as-is without warranty. Verify builds, keep your recovery phrase offline, and test with small amounts first.

PocketPRL reads balances, history and fee estimates from a Blockbook indexer and broadcasts through it. Keys never leave the phone, but the indexer learns which addresses you look up. Point it at your own instance if that matters to you.
